questions.q: How many deliverables does this lesson assemble for Elena Marsh?
options: Four
Five
Six
Seven
questions.explain: Seven deliverables: Income Statement, Balance Sheet, AP Aging, AR Aging, Reconciliation Report, Issue Log, and Implementation Documentation.

questions.q: What format does the Issue Log use for each of its six entries?
options: A simple yes/no checklist
Symptom, root cause, fix, and verification — the same format used in Troubleshooting Oracle Financials
A chronological narrative with no structure
A financial ratio comparison table
questions.explain: Each issue log entry follows the symptom/cause/fix/verified structure, consistent with the ticket format from the Troubleshooting Oracle Financials course.

questions.q: What does the Reconciliation Report specifically need to include regarding the bank variance?
options: Nothing — the bank item is omitted since it didn't require a GL fix
The bank's written confirmation that the duplicate debit was a transmission error and has been reversed
A request for LTV to switch banks
A projection of future bank fees
questions.explain: The reconciliation report ties the bank item exactly, with the bank's written confirmation of its duplicate-transmission reversal attached as evidence.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Implementation Documentation deliverable?
options: To list every Oracle Fusion menu path used during the project
To provide a narrative record of why LTV's enterprise structure and configuration decisions were made, for future reference
To replace the Issue Log entirely
To document only the bugs found in Oracle Fusion itself
questions.explain: Implementation documentation captures the reasoning behind Chapter 1's configuration decisions so a future consultant or hire can understand the 'why,' not just the 'what.'

questions.q: What distinction does this lesson draw between fixing a problem and delivering these documents?
options: There is no distinction — fixing and documenting are identical
Fixing the numbers and proving/documenting that they're fixed are two different, both-necessary deliverables for an executive audience
Documentation is optional once the trial balance is correct
Only the Issue Log matters; financial statements are optional
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly distinguishes between the correction itself and the documented proof an executive needs to defend the numbers to a board.
